workItems.title: Data Analysis & Automation Consultant
workItems.shortDescription: Transformed regulatory data into actionable insights for 10,000+ charitable organizations
workItems.detailedStory: Six-year engagement processing and analyzing large-scale regulatory datasets for Canada's charitable sector. Progressed from manual SQL analysis to implementing machine learning models for pattern recognition.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Challenge

Canadian charities submit complex regulatory filings with inconsistent data quality. Manual processing was error-prone and couldn't scale with sector growth.

### The Solution

Developed automated validation pipelines using SQL and Python. Implemented ML models to identify anomalies and predict compliance issues before they occur.

### The Impact

- Published sector-wide trend analyses reaching 10,000+ organizations
- Reduced data processing time from weeks to hours
- Created reusable automation templates now standard across the firm

### Academic & Media Citations

**Academic:** [Carleton University Research Note (2023)](https://carleton.ca/profbrouard/wp-content/uploads/PARGnote202439RNRegisteredcharitiesstatistics20240111FBML.pdf) | [Carleton T3010 Research Group (2025)](https://carleton.ca/profbrouard/t3010researchgroup/)

**Media:** [Hilborn Charity eNEWS (2024)](https://hilborn-charityenews.ca/articles/data-snapshot-the-canadian-charity-sector-2022) | [The Charity Report (2021)](https://www.thecharityreport.com/features/blumberg-snapshot/) | [Foundation Magazine (2022)](https://foundationmag.ca/how-much-did-the-largest-canadian-private-foundations-spend-in-2020/)

**Policy:** [Alberta Public Inquiry Report (2020)](https://open.alberta.ca/dataset/3176fd2d-670b-4c4a-b8a7-07383ae43743/resource/f8a8d0ff-24c1-427f-9989-f24283f75cd2/download/energy-report-public-inquiry-anti-alberta-energy-campaigns-sched-g-tax-memorandum.pdf)

workItems.title: Dormezy - Student Housing Platform
workItems.shortDescription: Founded venture-backed startup selected for WebSummit presentation
workItems.detailedStory: Identified critical inefficiency in student housing market. Secured $30,000 funding, built platform reaching 500+ beta users, selected from 2,400+ startups for WebSummit.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Opportunity

Student housing platforms hadn't evolved with user expectations. Existing solutions were fragmented, unverified, and difficult to navigate.

### The Innovation

Combined existing technologies in a novel way: verified listings, virtual tours, roommate matching, and integrated lease signing.

### The Validation

- Selected for WebSummit from 2,400+ applicants
- 500+ students joined beta within 2 months
- 12 property partners signed before launch

workItems.title: Phoebus Digital - Web Development Agency
workItems.shortDescription: Delivered high-impact web solutions for education and language learning startups
workItems.detailedStory: Agency work spanning multiple education technology projects. Specialized in rapid development, data aggregation, and scalable platforms.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Client Focus

Worked with education and language learning startups requiring fast, high-quality execution. Projects ranged from comprehensive university databases to viral learning platforms.

### Technical Approach

- Rapid prototyping and iterative development
- Data aggregation and scraping when needed
- Focus on user utility over flashy features
- Strategic guidance to prevent premature scaling

### Portfolio

Three major projects detailed below: ApplyVisa.au (university search), EnglishUnleashed (language learning platform), and L2English (IELTS certification).

workItems.title: ApplyVisa.au
workItems.detailedStory: Transformed stalled $50k project into functioning platform at zero external cost. Created searchable database of 40,000+ programs, now the leading research tool for Australian education.
workItems.explorationContent:
### The Problem

Client had commission deals with universities but no platform. Previous developers quoted $50,000+ with uncertain timelines. Existing sites prioritized conversion over utility.

### My Approach

- Scraped CRICOS government database and university sites
- Built filterable interface with session persistence
- Created SEO-optimized pages for each university and field
- Zero external costs, 3-week delivery

### The Result

Platform became the most comprehensive free resource for Australian education research. Natural conversion through utility-first design.

workItems.title: EnglishUnleashed
workItems.shortDescription: PDF store to 600,000+ users in 4 months
workItems.detailedStory: Evolved linguistics professor's concept from simple storefront to comprehensive learning platform. Strategic guidance prevented premature scaling while focusing on validated growth.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Phase 1: MVP (Week 1)

Simple PDF store using Gumroad API. YouTube integration for video catalog. Zero backend complexity.

### Phase 2: Viral Growth (Month 2)

AI-generated shadowing videos gained 200k subscribers. The 'soulless' AI voice was perfect for learners - clear, consistent, easy to follow.

### Phase 3: Platform Evolution (Month 4)

- Migrated from Gumroad to reduce fees
- Implemented quiz system
- Advised against premature features (app, AI chat)
- Focus: validate before expanding

### The Result

600,000 users. Complete platform ownership. Sustainable revenue model.

workItems.title: L2English
workItems.detailedStory: Collaboration platform connecting certified teachers with IELTS students. Clean execution focused on core value proposition.
workItems.explorationContent:
### Core Features

- Cambridge assessment integration for placement
- Tiered subscriptions (group/individual)
- Progress tracking and analytics
- Material distribution system

### Design Philosophy

No unnecessary features. Focus on connecting qualified teachers with motivated students. Everything else is noise.

### The Result

Clean platform that does one thing excellently: prepare students for IELTS certification.
